description: Per-equation rest-preservation gate (continuity, D(dp)/dt=flux_divergence_duo_g3) of the duo LMARS SWE. The full 6-rule system exceeds the 40 GB Slurm cgroup at build; this compiles only the continuity rule's RHS. Rest tendency exactly 0. Rust is REQUIRED here (Erk 1e-10/1e-12, ~49 s at the dev-opt2 build): this is the one duo case the Rust binding completes today, so it pins the whole duo pathway (geometry chain, duo_extend, LMARS continuity) cross-language.
